events.description: Called with a step's id when it is pressed; left out, the steps are not pressable.
events.name: onStepPress

props.description: The id of the step in hand; earlier steps read as complete, later ones as upcoming.
props.name: currentStep

props.description: `horizontal` (a row with connectors between) or `vertical` (a column). Defaults to `horizontal`.
props.name: orientation

props.description: `default`, or `compact`: "Step 2 of 4", the current step's name and a dot per step.
props.name: variant

props.description: `number` (1, 2, 3 in the customer's digits) or `icon` (each step's icon). A complete step shows a check.
props.name: marker

props.description: True (the default): only complete steps can be pressed. False: any step but the current one.
props.name: isLinear

props.description: The list's name, for example "Add a product"; defaults to the catalogue's "Progress".
props.name: label
